    'Cory': 'no',
    'Edwin': 'yes',

    'Anita': 'no',
    'Debra': 'no',
    'Morgan': 'yes',
    'Kevin': 'yes',
    'Kristin': 'yes',
    'Melissa': 'no',
    'Norman': 'no',
    'Robin': 'no'
}

# Read the current CSV content
csv_content = _mem['s12']['content']
lines = csv_content.strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0]
rows = lines[1:]

# Update each row
new_rows = []
for row in rows:
    parts = row.split(',')
    name = parts[0]
    invited = parts[1]
    rsvp = rsvp_map.get(name, 'unknown')
    new_rows.append(f"{name},{invited},{rsvp}")

GOAL
I have invited some of my friends to a reunion party via phone messages. I have made a CSV to track who is coming or not in "~/documents/personal_files/" in my file system. Please update RSVPs in it as per their latest replies.

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- supervisor.show_active_task()
- supervisor.show_profile()
- file_system.login(username, password)
- phone.login(username, password)
- file_system.show_directory(access_token, directory_path)
- file_system.show_file(access_token, file_path)

API DOCS ALREADY READ (exact signatures; do not call api_docs again for these)
